name: about_me
title: About Marko
description: Who Marko Milić is: headline, summary, focus areas, what he writes about, current availability and links. Call this first for any 'who is he / what does he do' question.

name: list_experience
title: Work experience
description: Marko's work history, newest first: company, role, dates, summary, highlights, tech. Also returns education. Optionally filter by a word or restrict to the current position.

query.description: Filter word: company, role or technology

name: list_skills
title: Skills
description: Technical skills grouped by category (languages, backend, security & identity, AI integrations) plus spoken languages. Optionally filter by a word.

name: start_quiz
title: Start the quiz
description: Starts a short multiple-choice quiz about Marko ("How well do you know Marko?"). Returns the intro and question 1 as a card: the widget shows the question and the choices, so write only the intro, never the question. Then call answer_quiz_question for each answer.

lang.description: Visitor language code: en, sr or de

name: answer_quiz_question
title: Check a quiz answer
description: Checks the visitor's answer to quiz question <number> and returns whether it was correct, the explanation, the running score and the next question as a card the widget shows (or finished=true with the final score): react and explain, do not write the next question. Pass correctSoFar from the previous result.

choice.description: The visitor's pick: a letter like 'B', 'B) text', or the choice text

correctSoFar.description: Correct answers before this one (from the previous result)

lang.description: Visitor language code: en, sr or de

name: get_quiz
title: The whole quiz
description: The whole quiz about Marko in one language, correct answers and explanations included, for an application that runs the quiz itself and checks answers without a model. When you are chatting with a visitor, use start_quiz and answer_quiz_question instead, so the answers are never in your context.

lang.description: Language code: en, sr or de

name: list_projects
title: Projects
description: Selected projects and open-source work with links and the tech used. Optionally filter by a word.

name: get_contact
title: Contact
description: How to reach Marko: e-mail, LinkedIn, GitHub, blog. Use whenever someone wants to hire him, collaborate, or simply get in touch.

name: get_availability
title: Free time / book a call
description: How to see Marko's free time and book an intro or interview call. Returns his booking page — which shows only his open slots and books instantly with a calendar invite — plus his timezone and US-Eastern overlap. Call this whenever someone asks when Marko is free, wants to schedule, or wants to book a call, then give them the booking link. (Read-only: booking happens on the page, not in chat.)
